boxes.text:
useAgentCanvasBridge
stableWorkspaceId + ephemeral canvasId -> register agent/canvases
poll commands -> handleAgentCommand -> reply; unregister on pagehide/cleanup
mutation receipt cache by command.id; context reads bypass receipt cache
publishLiveCanvasSelections(workspace) -> /api/mapping/live WebSocket

MappingPage.handleAgentCommand
context -> version + nodes + edges; document-state -> document + name
snapshot -> controller snapshot + history + saved identity
create-document / copy-document -> workspace sessions
apply-diagram-revision -> DiagramRevisionReceiver -> sync + storage.flush
apply -> requestId receipt + busy checks

MappingDocumentController.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
transact = same command path; 1..100 operations; version must match
clone document + canvas -> stage operations in order

create / insert / replace / patch -> DiagramService [G]
patches remap content-node anchors, jumps, folds, sections

projectCanvasSnapshot -> updateSnapshot(record=true)
reconcile connections/jumps; normalize folds; resolve floating geometry
append(document, canvas, node correspondence) -> history [E]
publish snapshot + version -> listeners -> return {version, nodes}

select(command) -> recorded selection update
updateCanvas(value, record=false) -> transient by default
